source.cloudflare: fresh account resources (worker, KV, D1, queue)

idea: A one-paragraph idea: a transparency-first worker collective that publishes its own live status and improves itself via queued executor ticks.

stages.action: Render roles, queues, and integrations from foundation/topology.py into a fresh repo scaffold.
Hire driver, scheduler, and executor roles from topology with bootstrap workers.json credentials.
stages.failure: executor role failed onboarding: missing queue binding in wrangler.toml.
stages.fix: added queue producer/consumer bindings to the generated wrangler.toml from topology.outputs.

stages.action: Seed the work queue with the initial tick order and this rehearsal item.
stages.failure: first seed write rejected: KV namespace not created on fresh account.
stages.fix: provision step now creates KV/D1/queue resources before seeding.

stages.action: Deploy scheduler tick worker; confirm cron fires and enqueues orders.
Deploy executor worker consuming queue orders and opening PRs.
stages.failure: executor denied on first PR: fresh repo had no default branch token scope for contents:write.
stages.fix: bootstrap provision grants the fine-grained token contents:write + pull-request:write at repo creation.

stages.action: Executor consumed the queued order, wrote the /live-style transparency page (public/live.html + worker route), and opened PR #1 with no human action.
CI checks ran on PR #1 and the executor merged it unattended after green checks.
Transparency page serves merged content at /live with run id, stage log, and latest merge sha.
Each stage's failure and fix recorded in this file; driver order satisfied.

merged_pr.title: bootstrap: transparency page from rehearsal order

porting_note: All platform-specific steps are isolated in stage 2-5 provision/deploy actions; topology and stage order are platform-neutral, satisfying the PORT-EXEC-1 porting test.
